dispatcher.description: Entry point for all user requests. Routes to judge for orchestration decisions.

judge.description: Orchestration decision maker. Analyzes state and outputs structured actions.

low-fixer.description: Simple, single-file changes: typos, config edits, mechanical replacements.

medium-fixer.description: Multi-file changes with clear scope, standard refactoring, test updates.

deep-fixer.description: Complex implementation, architectural changes, cross-system refactoring.

explorer.description: Fast codebase search and pattern matching.

oracle.description: Solves hard architectural and debugging problems.
